deepdive.sec: Oncology Care Services & Specialized Cancer Hospitals

bull_bear.body: Strategic divestiture of Milann (Fertility) for INR37.6cr equity consideration (75% upfront) to focus on core oncology; Rights issue of INR425cr completed to strengthen balance sheet; Debt repayment executed to reduce leverage to 1.4x; Internal net debt/EBITDA ceiling set at 2.5x.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Medical Value Travel (MVT) volatility due to geopolitical tensions (Middle East conflict); Execution risk on brownfield expansions; Competition from large multi-specialty chains entering oncology; Regulatory changes in healthcare pricing.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident, disciplined, and strategically focused; Emphasis on 'profitable growth' over pure topline chasing; Transparent on intentional revenue trade-offs for margin quality; Bullish on clinical differentiation as a moat.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Center utilization (58%) is a blended metric (chemo beds, OT, radiation machines) rather than just bed occupancy, indicating significant headroom in assets like Ahmedabad (50% utilization); ESOP settlement distorted cash flow conversion; MR-Linac deployed on pay-per-use to preserve capital efficiency.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- "Successfully Completed Rights Issue" — cited as having "Strengthened Balance sheet", "Enhanced financial flexibility" and left the company "Well positioned to fund future growth" (no issue size disclosed in the deck).
- Strategic-priority header pairs "ROCE Improvement" with "Disciplined capital allocation", alongside "Focus on Profitable Growth".
- Brownfield expansion framed as "Return focused capital investment" that is "Unlocking embedded capacity across network", with 60% of the FY30 bed addition to come from brownfield.
- Growth investment framework (priority C): brownfield expansion across key hospitals, strengthen presence in existing markets, and "Enter identified and attractive markets which fit the expansion framework".
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body: West Cluster: 45% of revenue, +14% FY26 growth; South Cluster: 39% of revenue, +13% FY26 growth (Q4 moderated by MVT softness); East Cluster: 11% of revenue, +11% FY26 growth; International (Kenya): +71% FY26 revenue growth.

business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- "Largest oncology-focused hospital chain with a pan-India network"; the About Us section calls HCG "the largest provider of cancer care in India" through a network of 26 hospitals across India and Kenya.
- Claims leading positions in 16 of 19 cities covered (deck notes: "HCG in top 3 based on management estimates", excluding Chennai), spanning 19 cities / 10 states excluding Kenya.
- Positioned as the "Preferred destination for leading oncologists": full-time and exclusive oncologists, integrated medical/surgical/radiation teams, organ-specific teams, 450+ revenue-generating oncologists and 88% doctor retention rate in FY26.
- Claims a "TRACK RECORD OF BEING 1st TO LAUNCH ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY IN INDIA" (Cyberknife, Tomotherapy, Radixact, Ethos/adaptive radiation, MR-LINAC dated 2026), backed by 1000+ papers published till date and 30+ new clinical trials in FY2026.
- Multi-disciplinary Tumor Board approach run weekly nation-wide for 17+ years, with 250+ oncologists participated and 36K+ cases discussed till date.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Divestment] "Completed Strategic Exit from Milann" — the fertility business was divested in June 26 (deck states the sale completed on 29th June, 2026), to sharpen focus on core oncology; it contributed revenue of INR 169 Mn and EBITDA of INR 23 Mn in Q1 FY27.
- [Shareholding] As on 30th June 2026: Promoters 64%, Domestic Institutional Investors 19%, Foreign Institutional Investors 3%, Public 14%.
- [Leadership/Governance] "Management Team Strengthened — Leadership team fully on-boarded"; board includes founder Dr. BS Ajai Kumar (Non-Executive Chairman), Dr Manish Mattoo (Executive Director and CEO) and two KKR nominees (Akshay Tanna, Partner; Simrun Mehta, Managing Director).
- [Provision] An "EPCG-related provision of INR 45.9 Mn" was recognised in Q1 FY27 and is excluded from the deck's Adjusted EBITDA, as are North Bangalore start-up losses of INR 70 Mn.
- [International] International business (Kenya operations, included in consolidated metrics) reported revenue of INR 208 Mn in Q1FY27, ~9% YoY growth, "driven by stronger patient inflows for radiation oncology and PET cases".
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body: EBITDA margin expanded 70bps FY26 to 18.5% (Q4 up 90bps to 19.2%); Drivers: Operating leverage, better utilization, throughput optimization, payor mix improvement (100bps shift in last 2 quarters); Cost levers: Procurement efficiencies, lease renegotiations; Intentional exit from low-margin business to improve realization.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: Revenue Growth: ~15% medium-term; Margin: Confident in continued expansion (targeting ~100bps in FY27); Order Inflow: Driven by 23 new oncologists added in Q4; Capex: INR90-100cr for 200 brownfield beds over 24 months.
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: N/A for hospital services; Pipeline includes 200+ brownfield beds (Cuttack +75, Ranchi +30, Vizag +50, Bhavnagar +20) over 24 months; 8-10 new Day-Care centers planned; 1,000 total bed addition target by FY30 (400 greenfield, 600 brownfield).
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Brownfield expansions in high-utilization centers (Ahmedabad at 50% utilization); Greenfield pipeline evaluating 10-12 cities (Pune, Surat, Coimbatore, etc.); Doubling Day-Care centers; Clinical talent addition (23 oncologists in Q4); Medical Value Travel recovery initiatives.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: HCG sharpened its strategic focus by divesting the fertility business (Milann) to concentrate purely on oncology, while delivering 15% FY26 revenue growth and 70bps margin expansion driven by volume growth and payor mix optimization. The successful INR425cr rights issue reduced net debt to 1.4x EBITDA, funding a 200-bed brownfield expansion pipeline aimed at sustaining double-digit growth and targeting 20% ROCE medium-term.
